description: This file defines a helper logging class 'Log' that provides static methods for logging messages at various levels. It acts as an abstraction over Android's native Log class, managing a linked list of LogNode instances to handle log data forwarding.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A utility class for logging that abstracts and manages a chain of LogNode objects to handle logging output.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode object to which log data is sent.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode object that will handle log data.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Dispatches the log message with a specified priority, tag, message, and optional exception.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message at VERBOSE priority.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message at DEBUG priority.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message at INFO priority.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message at WARN priority.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message at ERROR priority.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message at ASSERT priority.
